title: Automated Architectural Compliance Review
business: Architecture firms managing large-scale infrastructure projects.
problem: Project managers struggle to manually verify if thousands of sub-contractor PDF submissions comply with specific internal metadata standards, leading to compliance bottlenecks and delayed project audits.
solution: The Box MCP server enables an AI agent to programmatically traverse project folders, extract metadata fields from submitted documents, and cross-reference them against internal compliance schemas, automating the verification process.
steps: Configure the Box MCP server with read-only access to the designated project root folder.
Define the compliance metadata schema within the AI agent's system prompt.
Instruct the agent to iterate through sub-folders to identify files missing required metadata fields.
Generate a summary report of non-compliant files for human review.
outcome: A significant reduction in manual audit time and improved data consistency across project documentation.
limitation: The solution relies on the accuracy of existing file metadata; if metadata fields are empty or incorrectly populated at the source, the agent cannot verify compliance, which can be checked by auditing the agent's 'null' return values for specific metadata fields.
